UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 1, 2024
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Naiomi Rainey, President  Gloria Cordero, Commissioner
Gina Maguire, Vice President  Robert Shannon, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Secretary

Christopher J. Garner, General Manager  Richard Anthony, Principal Deputy City Attorney

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-51971  Recommendation to approve January 18, 2024 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-51972  Recommendation to adopt Resolution UT-1508 authorizing an amendment to the
  terms of compensation for the General Manager.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-51973  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute a one-year
  contract, with the option for two one-year extensions, with The Gualco Group to
  provide state advocacy and lobbying services, in an amount not to exceed $95,000.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-51974  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to issue a project task order to
  JIG Consultants under On-Call Professional Engineering Contract No. UT-3802 for
  the Large Potable Water Valve Replacement Project - De Ora Way, Palo Verde
  Avenue, Orange Avenue, El Dorado Park, and Wardlow Road (EO-3674) in the
  amount not to exceed $231,020.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-51975  Receive and file presentation on Gas Purchasing 101.

  Suggested Action:  Receive and file.

PUBLIC COMMENT
